clip-quad-turn-uses-wrong-corner: equivalent on the clip grid: tests/unit/test_clip_grid.cpp clips 30000 random paths (coordinates from 4 to the int32 range, repeated points, closed and open subpaths) to eight kinds of quadrilateral (rectangle, reversed, diamond, random, repeated corner, collinear corner, bow tie, no area) under four point caps and hashes the results; the hash is unchanged by this plant. Where a reason is known: a crossing's edge is put in lexicographic order first, so dx is never negative and the sign flag of the rounding of x is always 0; the 128-bit high words are zero for every product the callers form (their quotients are below 2^34). Checked on the grid, not proved.
